question: How is the sixteen-syllabled mantra-knowledge described in its efficacy?
premises: This mantra-knowledge is declared to have sixteen syllables
It is compared to a wish-fulfilling tree
A wish-fulfilling tree grants all desires
inference: The sixteen-syllabled mantra-knowledge is proclaimed to be like a wish-fulfilling tree.
plain_english: This sixteen-syllabled mantra is declared to be like a wish-fulfilling tree.
